explanationAr: في الإنجليزية يأتي المفعول به بعد الفعل مباشرة، ولا نضع بينهما ظرفًا: I like this job very much (وليس I like very much this job). وظروف التكرار مثل always و usually و often و never تأتي قبل الفعل الأساسي، وبعد الفعل be: I always check the data. He is never late. أما عبارات الوقت مثل yesterday و every day فتأتي في أول الجملة أو في آخرها، لا بين الفاعل والفعل.
explanationEn: In English the object comes straight after the verb, with no adverb between them: I like this job very much (not I like very much this job). Frequency adverbs such as always, usually, often and never go before the main verb and after be: I always check the data. He is never late. Time phrases such as yesterday and every day go at the start or the end of the sentence, not between the subject and the verb.
